name: export_motion_graphic_prores
description:
Export one or more motion graphics as transparent ProRes 4444 .mov renders.

Use this for the manual-equivalent "Export motion graphic" workflow and before NLE XML export when the XML should reference rendered motion-graphic media. The tool starts a cloud render and returns a durable renderId; use track_export with that renderId to wait for completion, then download through /api/v1/jobs/renders/{renderId}/download.

Pass itemId / itemIds when timeline instances should be exported exactly as previewed, including propertyOverrides. Pass assetId / assetIds for media-pool motion graphics; by default the backend will use the first timeline instance of each asset when one exists, matching the editor's media-pool export behavior. Use filenameMode="xml" when preparing motion graphics for submit_export format="xml", because XML references mg-<renderKey>.mov filenames.

External MCP ProRes rule: this starts one cloud ProRes render per target and requires the ProRes entitlement. For batches, export only the MGs needed for the requested NLE/XML handoff.

assetId.description: Motion-graphic asset id or prefix. Required when itemId is omitted.

assetIds.description: Motion-graphic asset ids or prefixes for a batch export. Use itemIds instead when timeline instance overrides matter.

filenameMode.description: asset = user-friendly asset-name .mov; xml = mg-<renderKey>.mov for submit_export XML compatibility. Defaults to asset.

itemId.description: Motion-graphic timeline item id or prefix. Prefer this when exporting a specific edited instance.

itemIds.description: Motion-graphic timeline item ids or prefixes for a batch export. Each item starts its own ProRes render.

name.description: Optional base filename for filenameMode=asset. .mov is added automatically.

preferTimelineInstance.description: When assetId is used, export the first timeline instance's property overrides if present. Defaults to true.

projectId.description: Existing project ID from the editor URL or list_projects. Pass this when continuing work on an existing project and the external MCP session is not already targeted.

timelineId.description: Optional timeline id/prefix to resolve itemId or the first timeline instance. Omit for the active timeline.
